## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are DCO signed (`git commit -s` / `Signed-off-by:`)
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] Does **not** add live third-party flooding / stolen-token abuse / unauthorized interference
- [ ] No new GPL/AGPL/SSPL dependencies without maintainer approval
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if user-visible
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/CATCH.md` / `DEPLOY.md` / `OPERATOR.md` / `acquisition.md` / `docs/IP.md`) when behavior or IP surface changes
